newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche interested in U.S. acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche interested in U.S. acquisitions.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said Tuesday it was interested in expanding its asset management business in the United States through acquisitions, but noted prices for U.S. asset managers were at an all-time high.
"We will keep trying ot expand organically but that is very difficult," Deutsche Bank board member Rolf Breuer told a news conference.
"In the U.S. we are interested in possible acquisitions, but prices are at an all-time high, so the question is not only one of opportunity but also one of price," he said.
Breuer said that Deutsche did not have a physical presence in asset management in Australia and would also be interested in an acquisition there if the opportunity arose.
